verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Zechariah 4

Self-filling lampstand fed by two olive trees; "not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit" to Zerubbabel, who had to finish the stalled work; "his hands shall also finish it"; the day of small things after "almost 20 years"; the two anointed ones are Zerubbabel and Joshua (possibly branches from trees representing the kingly and priestly offices)
